creativeDirection: Unconstrained creativity: experimental, artsy, spontaneous and imaginative. This user-approved interpretation replaces the previous punk/volatility direction.
design: Adult Vex with teal dyed hair, broad coral face-framing section and visible violet roots; messy half-up knot with a pencil. Violet eyes, purple wolf ears with pale inner fur and full purple wolf tail. Ivory paint-splattered artist smock, plum top, charcoal work trousers with one cuff, worn brown lace-up boots, plum sketchbook, paint-marked fingers and cheek. One arm cradles sketchbook while the other makes a loose conversational gesture.

baseDevelopment.prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve.
Asset type: ONE revised full-body visual-novel character sample of Unhinged Vex, for the user's design review.
Input image: identity and illustration-style reference. Preserve the same adult wolf woman in her late twenties, mature face and proportions, pale skin, violet eyes, rich purple hair, purple wolf ears with pale inner fur, and one full fluffy purple tail. Preserve the polished detailed anime painting style. Completely redesign the outfit, hairstyle arrangement, pose and expression as described.

Character direction from the creator: ARTSY, UNCONSTRAINED CREATIVITY. An experimental artist whose imagination refuses to stay inside the lines, discovering surprising connections and making things with fearless enthusiasm. Her mind is a busy workshop of ideas. Let her look inventive, absorbed and expressive.

Appearance: shaggy shoulder-length purple hair, loosely gathered into a small messy half-up knot, with one simple drawing pencil tucked into it and a few soft face-framing strands. Both violet eyes visible; readable, uncluttered hair silhouette. A loose warm-ivory linen artist's smock jacket, open, sleeves casually rolled to forearms, with a few convincing dried paint marks in teal, coral and ochre concentrated near the cuffs and lower pockets. Underneath, a simple opaque plum crewneck top. Comfortable charcoal work trousers with one casually cuffed hem and worn dark leather lace-up ankle boots. A few modest paint traces on her fingers and one tiny accidental paint smudge on a cheek. Clothes should feel lived in and used for creating, with natural fabric folds. Restrained silver earrings only.

Pose and acting: upright relaxed three-quarter standing stance with a slight inquisitive forward inclination, uneven shoulders and a lively small head tilt. One arm naturally cradles a closed, well-used plum sketchbook against her hip; the other hand is loosely raised in a small conversational gesture with relaxed natural fingers, as though sharing a surprising new idea. Keep gesture compact and compatible with later expression variants. Her violet eyes are bright, attentive and creatively engaged, one eyebrow gently lifted, mouth in an asymmetric open, delighted-in-the-idea smile with a tiny hint of canine. Curious self-assurance and imaginative freedom. One ear slightly cocked, tail with a relaxed lively curve.

Composition: portrait 1024 x 1536. ONE complete full-body character, entire ear tips, pencil, hands, sketchbook, tail and both boot soles inside the frame with comfortable clear margins. Level camera, coherent anatomy, soft even character illumination.
Background: genuinely transparent alpha, isolated sprite. No scenery, floor, cast shadow, glow, halo, haze or vignette.
No text, labels, logos, watermarks, extra characters, expression sheets or alternate views. No biker jacket, lime panels, armor, threatening pose, weapons, manic stare, exaggerated cartoon grin, or floating magical clutter.
